plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, file 26bsnatsci_pharmacy.pdf (2026-2027 Catalog), Version 2024/10/7. DOCUMENT HEADER QUIRK: the PDF's printed header reads 'Natural Science, BS, Pre-Veterinary' - identical to the veterinary-track file - but the file name, index-page listing ('Natural Sciences (Pharmacy Track)'), and course content (Human A&P I/II (Majors), Quantitative Analysis, no animal-focused courses) identify this as the Pharmacy Track plan; header kept verbatim and this discrepancy is documented rather than silently corrected. Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. ENGL 10103 and ENGL 10203 require a grade of C or better; ENGL 10203 lists PR: ENG 1463, coded as plan-level external_prereqs (excluded from credit sums per standing rules). Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 15+16+15+14+15+15+14+16 = 120; all printed semester totals reconcile with the course rows. 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed code. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course.
